title: How Fine-Tuning Objectives Shape Layer-Wise Information in LLM Hallucination Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.27711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Under matched conditions, classifier-head fine-tuning (\textsc{cls}) paradigm consistently outperforms the LLM-as-Judge sequence-to-sequence (\textsc{s2s}) on binary hallucination detection. We trace this gap to the representations induced by the two objectives. Static analysis shows that \textsc{cls} learns a task-specific discriminative direction, pushing hidden states into a clear two-cluster geometry with stronger class separation and linearly decodable label information. By contrast, \textsc{s2s} relies on the pretrained language-modeling head to make decisions. This minimizes the pressure to reorganize representations, leaving the hidden states much closer to the pretrained backbone. Our analysis also reveals that the \textsc{cls} signal saturates before the final layer, after which upper layers form a plateau of statistically interchangeable and largely redundant representations. translated_title: 微调目标如何塑造LLM幻觉检测中的逐层信息
translated_abstract: 在匹配条件下，分类器头微调（cls）范式在二值幻觉检测任务上始终优于LLM作为评判者的序列到序列（s2s）范式。我们将这一性能差距追溯到两种训练目标所诱导的表示差异。静态分析表明，cls学习到一个任务特定的判别方向，将隐藏状态推入清晰的双簇几何结构中，具有更强的类别分离性和线性可解码的标签信息。相比之下，s2s依赖预训练的语言建模头来做出决策，这最小化了重组表示的压力，使隐藏状态与预训练骨干网络保持得更加接近。我们的分析还揭示，cls信号在最后一层之前就已饱和，此后上层形成一个统计上可互换且基本冗余的表示平台。然而，仅凭端点冗余并不能表明……
tldr: 该论文发现分类器头微调（cls）范式在LLM幻觉检测中优于序列到序列（s2s）范式，原因在于cls学习到任务特定的判别方向，使隐藏状态形成清晰的双簇几何结构，且其信号在最后一层前即饱和，上层呈现冗余的表示平台。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that classifier-head fine-tuning (cls) outperforms LLM-as-Judge sequence-to-sequence (s2s) in LLM hallucination detection, because cls learns a task-specific discriminative direction that pushes hidden states into a clear two-cluster geometry, with its signal saturating before the final layer where upper layers form a largely redundant representation plateau.
